known_gaps_note: PyYAML declares build-backend = "_pyyaml_pep517" (a custom wrapper around setuptools), not a name detect_build_backend() recognizes as "setuptools" -- real loom usage never routes this project to discover_setuptools() at all, correctly falling back to the Hatchling heuristic instead (conservative, exact-match backend detection; see the original setuptools validation round's finding for this same package). Forcing assume_backend="setuptools" for this fixture (as its directory placement implies) still exercises a second, independent defense: PyYAML's flat layout has three top-level directories (lib/, yaml/, packaging/), so setuptools' own zero-config auto-discovery raises PackageDiscoveryError rather than guessing -- discover() correctly returns None either way, never a wrong file list.
